content.title: The Pitt Season 2: How to Watch if You Don’t Have HBO Max - IMDb
content.text: The Pitt Season 2: How to Watch if You Don’t Have HBO MaxHBO’s Emmy-winning medical drama The Pitt is back with Season 2, with the new season dropping on January 8, 2026, only on HBO Max. However, if you do not have HBO Max or live in a region where the service is not available, fear not.The Pitt Season 2 will now be available for streaming on Prime Video as well. However, you will need to pay an add-on channel fee to stream all HBO Max content alongside Prime Video’s regular content.
